title.title: The Locket
title.overview: People from different eras of time are transported to the present day by this strange locket passed through the generations. How do they return and if not can they cope in their new environment?

similar.title: Fight Dirty
similar.overview: When wealthy Queen Bee Kenzie makes a deal with high school bad boy Clay to be her fake boyfriend and bodyguard, she unknowingly steps into his dangerous world of illegal underground fighting - quickly igniting an undeniable attraction.

similar.title: The Bunjo
similar.overview: The Bunjo, by Grady Behrhorst, is an 8 minute proof of concept film and simply a masterpiece. The film leaves you questioning your religion, your sexuality, reality and the role of the commonwealth in your life. No film that I’ve ever seen has held such philosophical commentary.

similar.title: Devour
similar.overview: A struggling all female metal band called "The Virginia Bitches" have a taste for blood and while on tour their van breaks down in the middle of nowhere. Seeking help they come across a town full of cannibals led by an infamous Warlock.

similar.title: The Dark Knight
similar.subtitle: 2008 • PG-13
similar.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

similar.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
similar.subtitle: 2003 • PG-13
similar.overview: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men. Yet, the sole hope for triumph over evil lies with a brave hobbit, Frodo, who, accompanied by his loyal friend Sam and the hideous, wretched Gollum, ventures deep into the very dark heart of Mordor on his seemingly impossible quest to destroy the Ring of Power.​
